literal_meaning: গরুর মতো ঘাস খাওয়া (cow-like grass devourer)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ধনতন্ত্রের গোগ্রাসী প্রকৃতি কখনো তৃপ্ত হয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: The capitalist system's all-devouring nature will never be satisfied.
history: Refers to the endless way cows graze on grass, symbolizing unending consumption in Bengali folklore.
note: Idiom draws from rural imagery of cattle feeding habits.
